title: AI Product Strategy — Choose a Pain Worth Solving
key_insight: Find a frequent, important user struggle and describe the better outcome. Decide which part needs judgment or generation and which part should stay deterministic.
body:
## Choose a Pain Worth Solving

A team showcases generated text but users still spend the same time completing their work. The demo never addressed the bottleneck.

Find a frequent, important user struggle and describe the better outcome. Decide which part needs judgment or generation and which part should stay deterministic.

Test the riskiest assumption with a small workflow before building a platform. Evidence should measure the user job, not excitement about AI.
common_mistakes: An impressive model demo proves product value.
Inference price is the only product cost.
A strategy should continue regardless of failed milestones.
mini_exercise: Draw “Choose a Pain Worth Solving” as three labeled steps, then explain the decision at each step.
real_world_usage: Technical capability creates value only when it fits a user job, operating model, economics, and responsible adoption path.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Choose a Pain Worth Solving,” explain AI Product Strategy without assuming the listener knows AI engineering.
